jobs.title: Director, Integrated Planning & Procurement
jobs.description:
Reporting to

President & COO

Direct Reports

4 direct reports; approximately 8 team members in total

Purpose

The Director, Integrated Planning & Procurement is accountable for translating commercial demand into reliable material, procurement, production and inventory plans. This leader owns Select Foods’ end-to-end planning operating system, including demand planning, materials planning, procurement, production planning, inventory control, S&OP and the business ownership of SAGE MRP.

This is a hands-on executive leadership role in a lean, growing organization. The successful candidate must be equally comfortable developing long-term supply-chain strategy, leading an Executive S&OP discussion, coaching managers and personally working through an MRP implementation, supplier shortage, inventory imbalance or production-planning issue when required.

Responsibilities

Own and Lead S&OP
: Own, chair and continuously improve the monthly S&OP cycle: Demand Review, Supply and Capacity Review, Procurement and Materials Review, Integrated Reconciliation and Executive S&OP.

Establish one credible production plan, document assumptions and risks, and ensure unresolved service, capacity, inventory, cost and supply decisions are escalated to the Enterprise Leadership Team.

Connect volume plans to financial commitments, working-capital expectations and operating priorities.

Maintain clear meeting charters, calendars, inputs, decision rights, actions and follow-up disciplines.

Demand Planning:
Establish a disciplined demand planning process in partnership with Sales and Finance.

Create and maintain the unconstrained demand plan, incorporating baseline demand, customer intelligence, promotions, new business, losses and one-time events.

Monitor forecast accuracy and bias at useful product and customer levels; lead root-cause actions where performance falls outside agreed tolerances.

Challenge assumptions constructively and ensure demand changes are translated into supply, materials, capacity and inventory implications.

Materials Planning and SAGE MRP:
Act as the business owner of SAGE MRP and ensure it produces trusted, actionable recommendations.

Own planning policies and parameters, including lead times, safety stocks, order quantities, minimums, planning horizons, yields, scrap factors and make/buy settings.

Ensure BOM, master data, supplier and inventory data are sufficiently accurate to support reliable planning.

Lead root-cause correction to shortages rather than relying on manual workarounds.

Develop team capability and standard work for running, interpreting and maintaining MRP.

Production and Capacity Planning:
Convert the agreed demand plan into feasible medium-term capacity plans and executable production schedules.

Balance service, labour, equipment capacity, changeovers, material availability, shelf life, cost and inventory.

Establish planning time horizons, schedule change rules and a clear handoff from planning to operations.

Lead recovery plans when demand, supply or capacity deviates from plan.

Procurement and Supplier Performance:
Lead procurement strategy and execution for raw materials, packaging and other assigned categories.

Improve material availability, supplier reliability, lead times, commercial terms and supply resilience.

Implement supplier scorecards, regular performance reviews, risk mitigation and structured escalation.

Ensure purchasing decisions reflect total cost, minimum order quantities, working capital, service risk and quality requirements.

Inventory Strategy and Control:
Develop differentiated inventory strategies for make-to-stock and make-to-order products, raw materials, WIP and finished goods.

Segment items using demand variability, lead time, service expectations, shelf life, margin, MOQ, production frequency and supply risk.

Establish safety-stock, reorder, lot-sizing and coverage policies with clear ownership and review frequency.

Lead initiatives to reduce excess, obsolete and slow-moving inventory while protecting customer service and production continuity.

Manage overage, obsolete materials cost effectively including charge backs to customer as appropriate.

Partner with Finance and Operations to improve inventory accuracy, governance and working-capital performance.

Warehouse Operations and Carrier Management:
Oversee warehouse operations ensuring safe, efficient and compliant practices.

Align warehouse capacity, labour and processes with the production plan, customer service requirements and inventory policies.

Monitor warehouse and carrier performance through clear KPIs, regular reviews and corrective actions.

Lead carrier strategy and negotiate carrier contracts, rates and service terms to balance cost, reliability and customer commitments.

People and Functional Leadership:
Lead four direct reports and an overall team of approximately 8 across planning, procurement, warehouse and inventory control.

Set clear accountabilities, decision rights, standard work and performance expectations.

Coach managers and planners to solve problems independently while remaining close enough to the work to identify weak processes, data or controls.

Build succession, cross-training and technical capability across demand planning, supply planning, MRP, procurement and inventory.

Strategy and Continuous Improvement:
Develop and execute a multi-year roadmap for planning maturity, inventory, sourcing, capacity, systems and team capability.

Lead practical improvement initiatives that deliver measurable benefits in service, schedule adherence, inventory, supplier performance, cost and productivity.

Contribute to enterprise decisions bringing an integrated commercial, operational and financial perspective.

Translate strategy into clear priorities, owners, milestones and sustained operating routines.

Qualifications

10+ years of progressive leadership experience across supply chain planning in a manufacturing environment, with direct exposure to demand, materials and production planning.

Post-secondary degree in supply chain, operations, business, engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

APICS / ASCM CPIM or CSCP, SCMP, Lean Six Sigma or comparable professional development is an asset.

Demonstrated ownership or leadership of S&OP / IBP processes and cross-functional decision making.

Strong practical command of MRP logic, planning parameters, master data and exception management; experience with SAGE is preferred, while transferable ERP/MRP expertise is essential.

Experience developing inventory policies for both make-to-stock and make-to-order products.

Meaningful procurement and supplier-management experience, including performance, risk and commercial trade-offs.

Proven ability to lead managers and technical teams while remaining personally effective in detailed operational problem solving.

Ability to translate data into clear decisions for Sales, Finance, Operations and Leadership.

Strong change leadership, communication, analytical judgment and execution discipline.

Leadership Profile

Strategic and practical: sees the long-term system while understanding today’s details.

Enterprise-minded: optimizes the total business rather than one function.

Data-driven and decisive: converts imperfect information into clear, timely choices.

Coach and operator: develops people without becoming disconnected from the work.

Constructively challenging: tests assumptions and surfaces risks early.

Accountable and resilient: follows through and leads calmly through shortages, changes and competing priorities.

jobs.title: Head of PCI DSS Advisory (QSA) | Nov 23. 2026
jobs.description:
Head of PCI DSS Advisory (QSA) OBRYN GUARD Inc.
Remote
Cybersecurity | GRC | PCI DSS | SaaS | Hospitality

About OBRYN GUARD OBRYN GUARD Inc. is a Canadian cybersecurity and governance, risk and compliance technology company building a cloud-based platform for continuous control monitoring, cybersecurity risk management and compliance readiness.
Our initial focus is the hospitality industry, helping hotels and multi-property organizations improve visibility into cybersecurity risk, organize evidence, identify compliance gaps, manage remediation and maintain stronger ongoing readiness for frameworks including PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 27001.
We are building a global team across security, engineering, product, QA, solutions, operations and sales.

The Role We are seeking a Head of PCI DSS Advisory to lead OBRYN GUARD’s PCI DSS and payment-security advisory function.
This is a senior specialist role responsible for shaping how PCI DSS requirements are translated into practical customer workflows, platform methodology, evidence requirements, remediation guidance and hotel payment-security readiness.
You will work closely with our Head of Security, Engineering, Product, QA, Solutions and Leadership teams to ensure OBRYN GUARD’s PCI-related workflows are technically accurate, operationally practical and appropriately positioned as readiness and advisory support.
This role is particularly suited to someone with deep hands-on PCI DSS experience across complex merchant and payment environments.

Key ResponsibilitiesPCI DSS Leadership Lead OBRYN GUARD’s PCI DSS advisory methodology.
Interpret PCI DSS requirements and translate them into practical customer and platform workflows.
Support PCI DSS v4.x readiness programs.
Develop PCI control mappings, evidence requirements and remediation methodologies.
Help establish clear distinctions between automated controls, manual evidence and specialist review.
Review PCI-related platform functionality for methodological accuracy.

SAQ Readiness Support development of SAQ eligibility and readiness workflows.
Help determine what information must be collected before recommending an appropriate SAQ path.
Develop questionnaires and decision-support processes around merchant payment environments.
Identify situations requiring escalation to an appropriately qualified external assessor or QSA Company.

CDE & Payment Environment Scoping Develop repeatable methodologies for Cardholder Data Environment discovery and scoping.
Review payment flows, systems, connected environments and third-party dependencies.
Support documentation of where account data enters, moves through, is processed or may be stored.
Review segmentation, remote access, vendor access and systems capable of affecting the security of the CDE.

Hospitality Payment Security Support PCI readiness across hotel environments including:
Front desk payment terminals
PMS environments
POS systems
Restaurants and bars
Booking engines
Hotel websites
Payment gateways
Virtual terminals
Telephone reservations
E-commerce
Mobile payment environments
Spa, retail, parking and event payments
Franchise and management-company structures
Multi-property and shared-service environments

Third-Party Service Providers Review payment processor and TPSP responsibilities.
Develop shared-responsibility methodologies.
Support review of AOCs and vendor compliance evidence.
Identify gaps in third-party responsibility and evidence.

Evidence & Remediation Define acceptable PCI evidence standards.
Establish evidence freshness and sufficiency expectations.
Review customer evidence where appropriate.
Identify PCI readiness gaps.
Provide practical remediation guidance.
Support prioritization of material payment-security risks.

Product & Engineering Translate PCI requirements into product requirements.
Work with Engineering on technical feasibility.
Support Product with workflows and acceptance criteria.
Work with QA to validate PCI-related platform functionality.
Help ensure OBRYN GUARD does not incorrectly represent an automated result, integration or uploaded document as complete proof of PCI DSS compliance.

Customer & Solutions Support Support Solutions during customer onboarding and payment-environment discovery.
Participate in selected customer PCI readiness discussions.
Support complex hotel and enterprise engagements.
Review difficult PCI questions and escalations.
Help develop executive-ready PCI readiness reporting.

Required Experience Significant hands-on PCI DSS experience.
Strong understanding of PCI DSS v4.x.
Experience with merchant and payment environments.
Experience with SAQs and PCI readiness programs.
Strong understanding of CDE scoping and payment-flow mapping.
Experience reviewing PCI evidence and remediation plans.
Experience with payment gateways, processors, POS systems and third-party service providers.
Ability to interpret technical and compliance requirements and convert them into practical workflows.
Experience communicating with technical teams, leadership and customers.
Strong written documentation and methodology-development skills.

Preferred Experience Current or previous PCI SSC Qualified Security Assessor experience.
Experience working through or alongside a PCI SSC QSA Company.
Experience preparing or reviewing ROC, AOC or SAQ-related engagements.
Experience with PCI DSS Level 1 environments.
Hospitality, retail, payments or multi-location merchant experience.
ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2 or broader GRC experience.
Cloud, network, IAM or application-security experience.
Experience working with SaaS platforms or technology companies.
Certifications such as PCIP, PCI ISA, CISSP, CISA, CISM, ISO 27001 or similar are considered an asset.

Professional Boundaries OBRYN GUARD provides cybersecurity and compliance readiness technology and advisory support.
This role does not, by itself, make OBRYN GUARD Inc. a PCI SSC Qualified Security Assessor Company.
Where formal PCI DSS validation requires an appropriately qualified QSA Company or assessor, the engagement must be structured through the appropriate qualified entity.
Candidates with former QSA experience are welcome and encouraged to apply.

Who You’ll Work With You will collaborate closely with:
Head of Security, Risk & Compliance
Engineering
Product
QA
Solutions
Customer Success
Operations
Sales
Executive Leadership

The Head of Security retains broader responsibility for enterprise cybersecurity, security governance, SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST and overall security strategy.
The Head of PCI DSS Advisory provides specialist leadership across PCI DSS and payment security.
What Success Looks Like Success in this role means:
Clear and defensible PCI methodology
Strong hotel payment-environment discovery
Accurate SAQ readiness workflows
Consistent evidence standards
Practical remediation guidance
Strong collaboration with Engineering and Product
Efficient onboarding of paying hotel customers
Clear separation between readiness support and formal third-party validation
A scalable PCI advisory model that can support multi-property hospitality organizations

Engagement Remote.
Initial engagement may be structured as an independent contractor arrangement with the potential for expanded long-term responsibility as OBRYN GUARD grows.
Compensation structure may include agreed professional-services compensation and equity participation depending on experience, responsibilities and final agreement.

About You You are practical, experienced and comfortable operating in a startup environment.
You can move between detailed PCI requirements, technical teams, customer conversations and executive-level discussions without losing accuracy.
You understand that compliance is not a checkbox exercise and that strong PCI readiness requires proper scoping, evidence, remediation and professional judgment.
Apply If you have deep PCI DSS and payment-security experience and want to help build a scalable cybersecurity and compliance platform for the hospitality industry, we would like to hear from you.
OBRYN GUARD Inc.
Continuous Control. Proven Assurance.

Director
